events.verdict: Diallo (NOP) sets the screen in Forbes's (SAS) path and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Poeltl (SAS) makes incidental "high-five" contact with Jackson (NOP) after the release that does not affect his ability to follow through.
Pondexter (SAS) draws Frazier (NOP) into the air, but not directly towards him, before initiating contact during his jump shot attempt.
Forbes (SAS) makes contact with the ball but does not dislodge it, and he continues contact onto Jackson's (NOP) arm that affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Frazier (NOP) briefly grasps Poeltl (SAS) following the pick but does not affect his FOM.
Frazier (NOP) makes marginal contact to the non-shooting arm of Poeltl (SAS) during his shooting motion that does not affect his play at the basket.
Clark (NOP) makes marginal contact with Metu's (SAS) arm during his shot attempt.
Williams (NOP) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Pondexter (SAS) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Forbes (SAS) makes marginal contact to the body of Jackson (NOP) during his shooting motion that does not affect his play at the basket.
Jackson (NOP) makes contact with DeRozan (SAS) on-ball that does not affect his SQBR.
Aldridge (SAS) is firming up in a screening position in Jackson's (NOP) path when contact occurs and he absorbs contact.
Diallo (NOP) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Diallo (NOP) makes tactile contact to DeRozan's (SAS) arm during his drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Jackson (NOP) and Aldridge (SAS) make incidental contact during rebounding.
Mills (SAS) maintains a legal guarding position on Frazier (NOP) in transition.
Jackson (NOP) inbounds the ball within five seconds.
Gay (SAS) makes incidental contact to the arm of Frazier (NOP) after the release that does not affect his follow through.
Williams (NOP) commits a take foul on Aldridge (SAS).
Clark (NOP) commits a take foul on DeRozan (SAS).
LAR shows Gay (SAS) makes incidental contact to Jackson's (NOP) body before he begins his upward shooting motion on his jump shot attempt.
